description: The tab bar is a flex row of 6 tab buttons each flex:1 with whiteSpace:nowrap. On narrow screens it becomes horizontally scrollable via `.tdp-tabs { overflow-x: auto }` (900px media query). This introduces horizontal scrolling within the tab strip, which the rubric forbids for content but is a common/acceptable pattern for a tab control (tabs are navigation, not content). Severity low: the nowrap is on tab labels (navigation), and scrollbar is hidden. However per the strict 'NO horizontal scrolling anywhere' rule, this overflow-x:auto on the tab strip is technically a violation.
suggestedFix: To strictly avoid horizontal scroll, let the tab bar wrap instead of scroll on narrow widths: replace with `.tdp-tabs { flex-wrap: wrap !important; }` and `.tdp-tabs button { flex: 1 1 auto !important; }` so tabs wrap to multiple rows rather than scroll sideways.
